comment: Release conditions for every exact-pinned version in package.json (dependencies, devDependencies and overrides).
An exact pin is invisible to update-npm-deps.ps1 — that script upgrades caret ranges and skips exact versions — so
nothing would ever remind you a pin is stale. This file is what makes that check happen: run each `check` and compare
its trimmed stdout to `expect`. Equal means the pin is still required; different means the condition that justified
the pin has changed and the pin should be re-examined. `check: null` means no mechanical test exists — review it
manually instead of letting it go quiet. Every exact pin must have an entry here, and every entry must correspond to
a real pin. Same format as obsidian-dev-utils/pinned-versions.json; prose rationale lives in AGENTS.md.
Caret-ranged security overrides are NOT listed here — update-npm-deps.ps1 sweeps those on its own; see the
'Security overrides' section of AGENTS.md for when they can be dropped.

typescript.why: @typescript-eslint peer-requires >=4.8.4 <6.1.0, and its parser crashes on the TypeScript 7 (tsgo) native API, so type-aware ESLint cannot run on 7. 6.0.3 is also the newest stable 6.x. Exact so a dependency sweep cannot drift it forward.
